formalExpression: !(quarterRevenue>0) || !financialBasis || revenueQoQ missing || revenueQuarterYoY missing || valuationObserved!==true || priceBookRatio missing || announcementsVerified!==true
scanLevelPrerequisite: runAfterMarketScan aborts before scoring when FINANCIAL, VALUATION or ANNOUNCEMENTS quality snapshot is absent.

facts: A stock is emitted only when latest, previous and same-quarter-last-year single-quarter revenue reconstructions all exist.
subtractQuarter() returns only when reconstructed quarter revenue is >0.
Given positive latest/previous/last-year revenue, revenueQoQ and revenueQuarterYoY are finite growth values.
Every emitted stock receives a non-empty financialBasis descriptive string.
financial.consequence: For current canonical FINANCIAL.stocks rows, quarterRevenue>0 + financialBasis truthy + revenueQoQ observed + revenueQuarterYoY observed are a single producer-integrity bundle rather than four independent readiness dimensions.

facts: Rows with null/negative PB are rejected at validation.
Every emitted valuation stock receives valuationObserved=true and numeric priceBookRatio.
valuation.consequence: For current canonical VALUATION.stocks rows, valuationObserved and priceBookRatio-observed collapse to one symbol-membership/integrity bundle.

facts: runAfterMarketScan assigns announcementsVerified=announcements.sourcesVerified===true to every market row.
A symbol with no matching announcement need not have an officialAnnouncements array; Formal treats missing array as [].
announcements.consequence: On the current canonical validated path, announcementsVerified is a scan-global source state, not a per-symbol completeness dimension; after a successful current-version validated announcement snapshot it is structurally true.

denominatorImplications: Seven textual subconditions must not be counted as seven independent scarcity causes.
A promotion-grade per-symbol denominator needs exact pre-gate reach plus same-generation FINANCIAL and VALUATION symbol membership.
Global dataset count thresholds do not prove every same-day market symbol is covered.
A whole missing FINANCIAL/VALUATION/ANNOUNCEMENTS snapshot is a scan-level abort and must not be mixed with per-symbol completeness rejects.
observerVersionGuard: Use formal_gate_overlap_observer_v0_2 or equivalent corrected null/truthiness semantics. V0.1 is not safe for empirical counts.
historicalPITGuard: Existing mutable quality snapshots do not preserve immutable firstKnownAt. Current structural conclusions do not authorize historical outcome inference.
